title: Capitalize Names
prompt: A roster imports names in inconsistent lowercase text. Write a function that returns a new array where each name starts with an uppercase letter and the rest of that name stays lowercase.

explanation.beginner:
Example: capitalizeNames(["ada","grace"]) produces ["Ada","Grace"]. The result must follow this precise rule: A roster imports names in inconsistent lowercase text. Write a function that returns a new array where each name starts with an uppercase letter and the rest of that name stays lowercase. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “normalizes mixed case”: input [["ALAN","maRgaret"]] produces ["Alan","Margaret"]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
